description: Cross-platform streaming media center for movies, series, anime, and Live TV with CloudStream extensions and Stremio add-ons.
notes: The official portable ZIP includes Java and VLC; run Stream Goat\Stream Goat.exe after extracting.
User data (extensions, profiles, library, and settings) is stored under %APPDATA%\Stream Goat, outside the Scoop app directory. Scoop uninstall therefore does not remove that user data.
